newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai floods ebb in many areas, more rain in south.
newsitem.headline: Thai floods ebb in many areas, more rain in south.

text.p: The flood situation in Thailand improved at the weekend with water receding in many areas, but more heavy rains were expected in the southern part of the country, an interior ministry official said on Saturday.
The death toll remained at 91, with no new casualties recorded since October 22. The ministry estimated overall flood damage at 2.53 billion baht ($101.56 million).
Only two central provinces remained severely flooded. Water levels in major rivers have ebbed.
"Only the south seems to be vulnerable to floods at the moment due to (a) tropical depression which is moving to Vietnam," the official said.
The southern region is Thailand's major rubber growing area.
More than 781,290 hectares of farmland have been damaged so far since the monsoon season began late May.
